en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by my father, may Allah grant him mercy, that he said: We were told by Sa’d bin Abdullah, from Ya’qoub bin Yazid, from Muhammed ibn Abi ‘Umayr, from some of his companions, from Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him, that he said:
The kalala is when there is no parent nor child (to someone).
